item.title: Spring WebFlux Fundamentals — Non-blocking I/O and the Reactive Stack
item.description: Spring MVC assigns one thread per request. When I/O waits pile up, threads sit idle. WebFlux replaces this with an event loop-based non-blocking model. A summary of the structural differences from MVC, the Reactor pattern, and when to choose which.
